previous_statement: Raw-call packaging and complete t_1 ledger. Use the Stage-1 tag and record the supplied input map w, the named source C^{m+1}, the target pieces P_old,P_fresh, base scale t_1, the literal output sum map v_old plus v_fresh when m>1 and v_fresh alone when m=1, and the fixed amplification families just constructed; these are precisely the data fields of def-maincb-raw-call. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply complementary target projections, the old extended inclusion when present, and the fresh extended inclusion. Every relevant projection, complementarity, and map defect is bounded respectively by c_0^cb*epsilon, L*epsilon, C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, or C_pair*L*epsilon, and every ambient defect used is epsilon or L*epsilon; each is at most t_1 because K_1 dominates its coefficient. Node 1.1 gives 0<=t_1<=e_1. Thus this explicit Stage-1 raw-call datum meets every hypothesis of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement at base scale t_1.
new_statement: Raw-call packaging and complete t_1 ledger. Form the complete record before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. If m>1, record the Stage-1 tag; supplied input map w; named source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner/ambient A; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; target pieces P_old,P_fresh; literal sum map v_raw obtained from v_old and v_fresh via their corner-to-A inclusions; its fixed amplification family obtained by summing the supplied families; target-ambient defect epsilon; and d_raw:=D_1*t_1. If m=1, record the Stage-1 tag and w; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; v_raw:=v_fresh and its supplied family; target-ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon. The m>1 value D_1*t_1 is entered as a candidate record field before the inference, not assumed as an estimate: def-maincb-raw-call explicitly says that recording d_raw does not assert that the literal map is an extended inclusion or isomorphism. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply complementary target projections, the old extended inclusion when present, and the fresh extended inclusion. Their projection, complementarity, and component-map defects are bounded by c_0^cb*epsilon, L*epsilon, C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, or C_pair*L*epsilon; the recorded target-ambient defects are epsilon and L*epsilon. Each is at most t_1 because K_1 dominates its coefficient, and node 1.1 gives 0<=t_1<=e_1. Thus the explicit raw-call datum is complete before the external lemma is applied and meets every antecedent of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement at base scale t_1; its conclusion will certify the recorded candidate in the m>1 branch, while node 1.3 already certifies the m=1 raw defect.
